codex.velorise_staves.basics.card4.title: Espadas Imbuidas de Elemento
codex.velorise_staves.basics.card4.p1: • §eImbuir en Yunque:§r Combina Espada + §bEsencia§r (o §6Omni§r) en el §aYunque§r conservando encantamientos y Netherite (con §cAspecto Ígneo§r solo acepta §cPyro§r).
codex.velorise_staves.basics.card4.p2: • §6Golpe Cargado:§r Solo ataques completos (§e>= 90% carga§r) aplican §b1.0U§r y aumentan el daño con §6Derretido/Vaporizado/Intensificación/Rompehielos§r!
codex.velorise_staves.basics.card4.p3: • §7Sin Spam ni Resonancia:§r Clic rápido hace daño físico normal; los inmunes siguen recibiendo golpe físico; §cno cuentan para Resonancia ni límite§r.

codex.velorise_staves.innate.drops.p1: • §6Drop fijo (Bajas hostiles por jugador, sin Botín):§r Innato §e5%§r | Mutado §e15%§r | Omni Mutado §625%§r (sin Slimes/Magmas divididos).
codex.velorise_staves.innate.drops.p2: • §bCraft y Reparación:§r 7 Esencias ➔ §6Omni§r; §bAnemo§r ➔ Cargas/Vara de Breeze; repara bastones (§6Omni§r repara todos).
codex.velorise_staves.innate.drops.p3: • §6Mejora Omni (Herrería):§r En la §aMesa de Herrería§r, combina §ePlantilla de Netherite + Bastón + Esencia Omni§r para crear el §6Bastón Omni / Netherite§r conservando encantamientos!

item.velorise_staves.splendor_of_tranqui: Furina's royal scepter. Tap Right-Click to summon Salon Solitaire (Ousia: 3 Hydro companions that silently drain 2% HP above 50% Max HP for up to 1.4x DMG) or Singer of Many Waters (Pneuma: heals 1 heart every 2s) for 15s. item.velorise_staves.netherite_splendor_: Esplendor de las Aguas Silenciosas de netherita

Netherite-forged royal Hydro scepter. Tap Right-Click to summon enhanced Salon Solitaire (1.5U Hydro) or Singer of Many Waters (8m AoE healing) for 15s. Hold Right-Click for 0.5s (Charged Attack) to switch Ousia/Pneuma at any time. Grants Water Walking & Fanfare (+30% DMG & Healing).

codex.velorise_staves.staff.splendor: Summons Ousia Salon Solitaire (3 Hydro pets, silently drains >50% HP for up to 1.4x DMG) or Pneuma Singer of Many Waters (heals 1§f§r/2s Basic, scales with Max HP on Netherite). Grants Water Walking & Fanfare (+25%→+30% DMG/Heal).
item.velorise_staves.vortex_vanquisher.d: Zhongli's Geo polearm (Dominus Lapidis). Tap Right-Click (4s CD): Summons a 3.5m Stone Stele (30s; shares the default max 3 Geo Constructs cap; places vertically on ground or horizontally when aiming at a block's side face; does not taunt mobs) pulsing AoE Geo waves every 2s. Hold Right-Click 1.5s (12s CD): Unleashes Geo shockwave (2 hearts + 1.9% Max HP), forms a Jade Shield (20s, 150% All-DMG absorption & -20% All Elemental/Physical RES to nearby foes) and summons 1 Stone Stele if below the 3-construct cap.
item.velorise_staves.netherite_vortex_va: Netherite-forged Geo Archon polearm. Tap Right-Click (4s CD): Summons a 3.5m Stone Stele (30s; shares the default max 3 Geo Constructs cap; vertical or horizontal on block sides; no mob taunt). Hold Right-Click 1.5s (12s CD): Unleashes Geo shockwave (3 hearts + 1.9% Max HP), forms a stronger Jade Shield (20s, 150% All-DMG absorption & -20% All Elemental/Physical RES to nearby foes) and summons a Stone Stele if below the 3-construct cap.
